stories.headline: China's YMTC Plans Two New Fabs to More Than Double Flash Memory Production

key_facts.fact: YMTC plans to build two additional factories on top of a third fab completing this year, which would more than double its production capacity once all three are operational.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese chipmaker Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC) plans to build two more factories in addition to one that will be completed in 2026, more than doubling its production capacity.

key_facts.fact: Each of the three new fabs will have a capacity of 100,000 wafers per month at full utilization. YMTC's current two fabs produce 200,000 wafers per month combined.
key_facts.excerpt: De drie nieuwe fabrieken zullen elk een capaciteit hebben van 100.000 wafers per maand wanneer ze volledig operationeel zijn... beschikt momenteel over twee fabrieken die gezamenlijk 200.000 wafers per maand kunnen produceren.

key_facts.fact: YMTC's third fab in Wuhan should start production by end of 2026 and reach 50,000 wafers/month by 2027. The building is complete and equipment installation is underway, with over 50% of equipment sourced domestically.
key_facts.excerpt: De derde fabriek van YMTC... zou eind dit jaar de productie moeten starten en tegen 2027 een capaciteit van 50.000 wafers per maand moeten bereiken... Meer dan 50% van de apparatuur is afkomstig van binnenlandse bedrijven.

key_facts.fact: YMTC held 11.8% of the global NAND flash market in 2025 according to UBS, with the firm projecting its share will exceed 14% by early 2027. Samsung leads at 30.4%.
key_facts.excerpt: YMTC vorig jaar goed voor 11,8% van de wereldwijde NAND-flashmarkt... Samsung de markt aanvoert met 30,4%... UBS voorspelt dat het aandeel van YMTC tegen begin 2027 de 14% zal overschrijden.

key_facts.fact: All three new fabs will allocate part of their capacity to DRAM production, marking YMTC's expansion beyond NAND flash. The company has sent LPDDR samples to customers and expects mass production by year-end.
key_facts.excerpt: Alle drie de nieuwe fabrieken zullen een deel van de capaciteit toewijzen aan de productie van DRAM... YMTC heeft monsters van energiezuinige DRAM (LPDDR) naar klanten gestuurd.

key_facts.fact: A bipartisan group of US lawmakers this month proposed the MATCH Act, which would ban the sale of older DUV lithography machines to Chinese chipmakers like YMTC, expanding existing export controls beyond EUV systems.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed 'MATCH Act,' recently introduced in the U.S. House of Representatives... aims to prohibit the sale of older deep ultraviolet (DUV) machines to Chinese chipmakers like SMIC, Huawei, and YMTC.

stories.headline: Oracle Expands Bloom Energy Partnership to 2.8 GW of Fuel Cells for AI Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Oracle and Bloom Energy expanded their partnership under a master services agreement for up to 2.8 GW of Bloom's solid oxide fuel cell systems to power AI and cloud infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Under a master services agreement, Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of Bloom's fuel cell systems.

key_facts.fact: An initial 1.2 GW of capacity has been contracted, with deployment underway across Oracle projects in the US and continuing into next year.
key_facts.excerpt: An initial 1.2 GW of capacity has been contracted, with deployment underway and continuing into next year.

key_facts.fact: Last year Bloom Energy delivered a fully operational fuel cell system to Oracle in just 55 days, over a month ahead of the expected 90-day deployment schedule.
key_facts.excerpt: Last year, Bloom Energy delivered a fully operational fuel cell system to Oracle in just 55 days—more than a month ahead of the anticipated 90-day deployment schedule.

key_facts.fact: Oracle received a warrant to purchase $400 million of Bloom Energy stock on April 9, on terms previously announced in October 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle filed a $400 million warrant to purchase Bloom Energy stock, registered through a regulatory filing on Monday.

key_facts.fact: Bloom Energy shares rose 6% to $176.67 in regular trading and surged to $198.65 in extended trading, up 12.6%. The stock has more than doubled in value this year.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of the company rose 12.6% at $198.65 in extended trading.

key_facts.fact: Oracle stock surged 12.69% to $155.62 on Monday following the announcement, significantly outpacing the broader market.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle stock surged 12.69% to $155.62 on Monday, after the company announced a sweeping energy partnership with Bloom Energy.

stories.headline: Intel Adds $100B+ in Market Value in Record 53% Nine-Day Rally on Terafab, Google Deals

key_facts.fact: Intel shares soared 53% in nine sessions including Monday, the largest such rally on record for the company, adding more than $100 billion in market value and pushing its market cap above $325 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares just posted their best week since January 2020 and have soared 53% in nine sessions, including Monday. This is the most on record for any similar stretch of trading.

key_facts.fact: Intel joined Elon Musk's Terafab project to develop semiconductors for Tesla, SpaceX and xAI, followed by Google committing to use future Intel Xeon processors in data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel said it would join Elon Musk's Terafab project to develop semiconductors for Tesla Inc., SpaceX and xAI. That was followed by a commitment for Alphabet Inc.'s Google to use future generations of Intel's Xeon processors in data centers.

key_facts.fact: Intel agreed to buy back a 49% stake in its Ireland Fab 34 from Apollo Global Management for $14.2 billion, signaling a shift from survival mode to expansion mode.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel agreed to repurchase a 49% stake in its Ireland Fab 34 facility from Apollo Global Management for $14.2 billion, a move widely viewed as signaling a renewed focus on capacity expansion.

key_facts.fact: The US government's stake in Intel is now worth roughly $27 billion, more than three times its original investment.
key_facts.excerpt: The government's stake is now worth roughly $27 billion, more than three times its original investment.

key_facts.fact: Intel's stock is up 72% year-to-date after an 84% jump in 2025 but trades at over 90x estimated forward earnings, its highest on record. Only 10 of 52 analysts have buy ratings.
key_facts.excerpt: The stock is trading at more than 90 times estimated earnings for the next 12 months, its highest on record... Of the 52 analysts tracked by Bloomberg who follow the shares, just 10 have buy ratings.

key_facts.fact: Benchmark raised its price target to $76 and Cantor Fitzgerald to $60. Intel reports Q1 earnings on April 23.
key_facts.excerpt: Benchmark: Buy (Raises Target to $76.00) (April 10). Cantor Fitzgerald: Neutral (Raises Target to $60.00) (April 9).

stories.headline: Missouri Voters Oust All 4 Council Incumbents After $6B Data Center Approval

key_facts.fact: All four incumbent Festus, Missouri city council members running for reelection were voted out one week after the council voted 6-2 to approve a $6 billion data center on 360 wooded acres.
key_facts.excerpt: In Festus, a town of about 12,000 south of St. Louis, all four city council incumbents seeking reelection were voted out after backing a $6 billion data center project.

key_facts.fact: Voter turnout was 129% higher than the April 2025 municipal election. First-time candidate Rick Belleville, 70, won by almost 45%.
key_facts.excerpt: Turnout was reportedly 129% higher than the April 2025 municipal election... One winner, 70-year-old first-time candidate Rick Belleville, who won by almost 45%.

key_facts.fact: The project, led by Clayco's development arm CRG, has an undisclosed Fortune 100 end user (codenamed 'Project Cumulus'). A lawsuit was filed alleging secret meetings, inadequate public notice, and Sunshine Law violations.
key_facts.excerpt: The project, led by Clayco's data center development arm CRG, spans 360 acres and has an undisclosed Fortune 100 end user (codenamed Project Cumulus). The city council signed off on the project without a public hearing.

key_facts.fact: Records requests surfaced texts in which unnamed city figures referred to critics as 'uneducated people' and discussed a 'need to keep the flock herded.'
key_facts.excerpt: Records requests surfaced texts in which unnamed city figures referred to critics as 'uneducated people' and talked about a 'need to keep the flock herded.'

key_facts.fact: Activists with Wake Up JeffCo are gathering signatures to recall the mayor and remaining council members. The group Data Center Watch counts 188 organized opposition groups across 40 states, with $162 billion in halted or delayed projects.
key_facts.excerpt: The advocacy group Data Center Watch... has updated the number of organized opposition groups from 142 a year ago (in 24 states) to 188 (across 40 states). The value of halted or delayed projects has risen from $64 billion to $162 billion.

stories.headline: Uber and Lucid Expand Robotaxi Partnership to 35,000 Vehicles With $750M in New Investment

key_facts.fact: Uber and Lucid expanded their robotaxi partnership from 20,000 to at least 35,000 vehicles, including Lucid Gravity and upcoming Midsize models, for Uber's future global robotaxi service.
key_facts.excerpt: Uber and Lucid have agreed to expand their robotaxi partnership to at least 35,000 vehicles designed exclusively for use as part of Uber's future global robotaxi service.

key_facts.fact: Uber committed an additional $200 million investment in Lucid, bringing its total investment to $500 million. Saudi Arabia's PIF (via Ayar Third Investment) committed a separate $550 million investment.
key_facts.excerpt: Uber to increase total investment in Lucid to $500 million with an additional commitment of $200 million... Ayar Third Investment Company... to purchase $550 million of Lucid's convertible preferred stock.

key_facts.fact: The companies plan commercial launch of their robotaxi service later this year in the San Francisco Bay Area using Lucid Gravity SUVs with Nuro's Level 4 autonomous driving technology.
key_facts.excerpt: The companies prepare for commercial launch of their next-generation robotaxi service later this year in the San Francisco Bay Area, utilizing the award-winning Lucid Gravity.

key_facts.fact: Lucid also named Silvio Napoli (former CEO of Schindler Group) as permanent CEO, replacing interim CEO Marc Winterhoff who moves to COO.
key_facts.excerpt: The company announced it has found a permanent CEO in Silvio Napoli. Napoli was formerly CEO of the Schindler Group, one of the world's biggest manufacturers of elevators and escalators.

key_facts.fact: Lucid's preliminary Q1 2026 results show revenue of $280-284 million, an operating loss of ~$1 billion, production of 5,500 vehicles, and deliveries of 3,093 units. Full-year production guidance of 25,000-27,000 vehicles was reaffirmed.
key_facts.excerpt: Preliminary Q1 2026 results show revenue between $280–284 million, an operating loss of about $(1.0) billion... production of 5,500 vehicles and deliveries of 3,093, with full-year production guidance of 25,000–27,000 vehicles reaffirmed.

stories.headline: 100+ Robots at Hong Kong Exhibition as China Scales Humanoid Mass Production

key_facts.fact: More than 100 robots were showcased at two exhibitions starting Monday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, demonstrating capabilities from conversation and boxing to backflips and security patrol.
key_facts.excerpt: More than 100 robots were showcased at two exhibitions starting Monday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center.

key_facts.fact: China had more than 140 humanoid-robot manufacturers and 330+ models in 2025. Omdia ranked AGIBOT, Unitree Robotics, and UBTech as the only first-tier vendors globally, each shipping over 1,000 units in 2025, with AGIBOT and Unitree exceeding 5,000 units each.
key_facts.excerpt: Official data showed China had more than 140 humanoid-robot manufacturers and more than 330 models in 2025. London-based Omdia ranked three of them — AGIBOT, Unitree Robotics and UBTech — as the only first-tier vendors... shipping more than 5,000 units.

key_facts.fact: EngineAI's Robert Chan said the company plans to launch two factories in China for mass production this year, noting China's advantages in low-cost engineering and industry know-how sharing.
key_facts.excerpt: Robert Chan, global strategy officer at EngineAI, based in Shenzhen, brought its PM01 robot to showcase its mobility, including doing a front flip. His company plans to launch two factories in China for mass production this year.

key_facts.fact: Shenzhen launched its first pilot production line specifically for humanoid robots on April 12, assembling Leju Robotics' Roban 2 in about two hours per unit. A mass production facility in Foshan targets 10,000+ units per year.
key_facts.excerpt: Am 12. April startete Shenzhen seine erste Pilotproduktionslinie, die speziell für humanoide Roboter ausgelegt ist. Sie montiert den 'Roban 2' von Leju Robotics in nur etwa zwei Stunden pro Einheit... Eine Massenproduktionsstätte in Foshan soll eine Jahreskapazität von über 10.000 Einheiten erreichen.

key_facts.fact: Unitree Robotics listed its R1 humanoid on AliExpress for $6,800-$8,100, targeting global consumers. The company shipped 5,500 humanoid units in 2025 and targets 20,000 in 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Having claimed the global shipment lead with 5,500 humanoid units delivered in 2025, Unitree has set its sights on shipping 20,000 units in 2026.

key_facts.fact: Shenzhen DX Intech sold more than 400 hyper-realistic female humanoid robots with soft synthetic faces, signaling a move toward emotional and lifelike interaction.
key_facts.excerpt: Wang Zuhua, business director at Shenzhen DX Intech Technology Co., said that the company sold more than 400 robots designed with female features and soft synthetic faces.

stories.headline: Global Semiconductor Equipment Sales Hit Record $135.1B in 2025, Up 15%

key_facts.fact: Worldwide semiconductor manufacturing equipment sales rose 15% to a record $135.1 billion in 2025, up from $117.1 billion in 2024, driven by AI-related capacity investment.
key_facts.excerpt: Worldwide semiconductor manufacturing equipment sales rose 15% to a record US$135.1 billion in 2025 from US$117.1 billion a year earlier, driven by investment in advanced logic, memory, and AI-related capacity.

key_facts.fact: The growth was driven by investment in advanced logic, memory, and AI-related capacity as chip companies accelerate fab buildouts to meet demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Driven by investment in advanced logic, memory, and AI-related capacity.

key_facts.fact: SEMI had previously reported 10% growth in global semiconductor equipment sales for 2024, reaching the prior record of $117.1 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: SEMI reports 10% growth in global semiconductor equipment sales in 2024, reach record of US$117.1 billion.

key_facts.fact: ASML, the sole manufacturer of EUV lithography tools, enters Q1 2026 earnings (April 15) with a $38.8 billion order backlog and expected revenue of $10.1-10.2 billion for the quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's order backlog stood at €38.8 billion at the start of the year... analysts expect revenue of $10.1 billion to $10.21 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 14% to 15%.
